Cloud

การแบ่งส่วนเครือข่ายคลาวด์

The process of dividing a cloud network into isolated segments or zones to control traffic flow and limit lateral movement by attackers. Enables granular access controls and policy enforcement between workloads.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The process of dividing a cloud network into isolated segments or zones to control traffic flow and limit lateral movement by attackers. Enables granular access controls and policy enforcement between workloads.

Operational example

Ensure cloud network segmentation is active to prevent unauthorized east-west movement between workloads, especially for PCI DSS regulated environments.
